claim.claim-text: 1. A method implemented using one or more processors, comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the data indicative of the vocal utterance comprises an audio recording of an utterance by the user, and the machine learning model is trained to generate output indicative of an age of the user based on one or more phonemes contained in the audio recording.

3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the data indicative of the vocal utterance comprises a textual interpretation of an utterance by the user, and the trained machine learning model is trained to generate output indicative of an age of the user based on vocabulary or grammar in the textual interpretation.

4. The method of any preceding claim, further comprising selecting, from a plurality of candidate natural language generation models, a given natural language generation model that is associated with the predetermined age group, wherein the selected given natural language output model is used to generate the responsive data.

5. The method of claim 4, wherein the plurality of candidate natural language generation models include at least one candidate natural language generation model that uses a larger vocabulary than a vocabulary used by the given natural language output model.

6. The method of claim 1, wherein the vocal utterance comprises a request for information, and resolving the intent includes summarizing information from a webpage that is responsive to the request for information, wherein the webpage is summarized at a degree of complexity that is commensurate with the predetermined age group.
7. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the given query understanding model is applied to perform speech-to-text processing of the vocal utterance.
8. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the given query understanding model is applied to perform natural language understanding of speech recognition output generated from the vocal utterance.
9. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the grammatical tolerance comprises a minimum confidence threshold.
10. A method implemented using one or more processors, comprising:

11. The method of claim 10, further comprising selecting, from a plurality of candidate natural language generation models, a given natural language generation model that is associated with the predetermined age group, wherein the selected given natural language output model is used to generate the responsive data.

12. The method of claim 11, wherein the plurality of candidate natural language generation models include at least one candidate natural language generation model that uses a larger vocabulary than a vocabulary used by the given natural language output model.

13. The method of any of claims 10 to 12, wherein the vocal utterance comprises a request for information, and resolving the intent includes summarizing information from a webpage that is responsive to the request for information, wherein the webpage is summarized at a degree of complexity that is commensurate with the predetermined age group.
14. The method of any one of claims 10 to 13, wherein the given query understanding model is applied to perform:
speech-to-text processing of the vocal utterance; and/or natural language understanding of speech recognition output generated from the vocal utterance.

15. A system comprising one or more processors and memory operably coupled with the one or more processors, wherein the memory stores instructions that, in response to execution of the instructions by one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to perform the method of any of claims 1 to 14.
